Our Mission

Fighting HIV/AIDS
With Compassion

Apaana Foundation was born from a belief that no one should face HIV/AIDS alone. We provide comprehensive care — from testing to treatment to emotional support.

Prevention & Testing Free HIV testing, counseling, and awareness campaigns across 47 communities
Treatment Support ART medication access, adherence counseling, and nutritional support programs
Community Empowerment Reducing stigma and building resilient communities through education and peer support
PMTCT Programs Preventing mother-to-child transmission — protecting the next generation

Real Stories

Voices of Hope & Change

Hear from the people whose lives have been transformed through your generosity and our work.

"Apaana gave me more than medication — they gave me hope. I was afraid and alone when I was diagnosed. Their counselors helped me understand my condition and live fully. Today I am healthy and educating others in my village."
Agnes Mukasa
Beneficiary, Kampala
"As a donor based abroad, I needed to trust that my money was making real impact. Apaana's transparency reports and regular updates give me complete confidence. I see photos of the children I'm helping — it's incredibly meaningful."
Robert Nakato
Monthly Donor, Diaspora
"My baby is HIV-negative, thanks to Apaana's PMTCT program. When I found out I was positive during pregnancy, I panicked. The team supported me every step — antenatal care, delivery, and follow-up. My daughter is perfectly healthy."
Joyce Opio
PMTCT Program Graduate
